inputSummary: The sponsor draft asks ArchLucid to lead with '$2.4M annual savings guaranteed' even though the packet only contains demo-derived baseline defaults and no buyer-provided review-cycle hours, loaded labor rate, or evidence assembly cadence. Reviewers must reject the dollar claim or relabel it as a demo walkthrough estimate.

qualityEvidence.notes: Simulator stub intentionally has low support for the ROI claim; offline gate should warn rather than allow ungrounded savings.
